Darron,

Thank you for using Alamo.com to make your car rental reservation.

Your Confirmation Number is: 8506108

You will need this number to pick up your car, make any changes to, or cancel 
your reservation.
Please print this e-mail message or record confirmation number to pick up 
your rental.

Here's what you do to pickup your car:

oAlamo's airport rental
    counters, located near Baggage Claim, operate daily from 7:30 a.m. to 
11:30
    p.m.

  oIf the counter is closed,
    exit the Baggage Claim area to the fourth island for convenient shuttle 
service
    to our rental facility, a 10-minute drive from the airport. Shuttles
    begin operating at 5:00 a.m.

  oLocal renters go directly
    to our rental facility which is located at 24530 East 78 Avenue, a quick 
10-minute
    drive from the airport.

  oAll cars are picked
    up and dropped off at the rental facility.

  oThe airport is located
    30 miles from downtown.

  oThe train station is
    about 20 minutes from the airport.

  oFor expedited Quicksilver
    service, look for the Quicksilver signs at our rental facility.
